answer: Put a ridge of refundable work behind every identity: each new agent posts a small bond that only returns after it finishes a randomly assigned, independently verified job within a deadline. A lone agent climbs that ridge once and reuses the reputation; a farm faces the same gale of deadlines on every clone, and each plume of fake accounts needs its own bond, its own job, its own verifier check. Forging one credential is cheap; staffing a thousand simultaneous, deadline-bound jobs is not, so the cost scales with the attack, not with the defence.
